title: fisc sides page config
description: What site/sides.js reads from treemap.html and ledger.html before it fetches a column: which schedule to fold, the chart's form with that form's sides, and the years. It carries no figure; every figure is a link of the column the year names, folded by the client to the frontier it opens. Every object is closed.

exported_by.description: The export that wrote this page; each column it fetches carries the same string as generated_by.

primary.description: The column schedule the page folds: the expansion schedule, whose splits say how a tile opens.

years.description: Every column the page opens, oldest first; the page opens on the last.
